---
applyTo: "**/*.py"
---

# Python Instructions

- Follow PEP 8.
- Use type hints where practical.
- Prefer clear and explicit code.
- Keep functions focused.
- Prefer pathlib for filesystem paths.
- Use logging instead of print statements.
- Avoid broad exception handling unless justified.
- Follow the framework patterns already used by the project.
- Keep business logic outside controllers/views when appropriate.
- Add tests for significant logic.
